[list]
[*][b]Switch Pointer Hand:[/b] You can now switch the pointer hand by pressing the controller trigger.

[/list]
We hope this update enhances your experience. As always, there might still be a few bugs, so your feedback is essential. Thanks for your continued support as we keep refining the simulator!

notes.title: Major Update Takes Flight with New Traffic, Aircraft, and Enhanced Routing!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 0.610: Major Features and Improvements[/h1]

Hello, Controllers! We’re thrilled to announce Update 0.610, packed with exciting new features and improvements to elevate your experience. After some time without a major release, we wanted to get this update out to you despite a few known bugs. Thanks to your feedback, we’re constantly improving. Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*][b]Random VFR Traffic Generation:[/b] The previous "Test Mode" is now Endless Mode, featuring customizable minimum and maximum traffic intervals for both IFR and VFR. Time intervals are now shown in minutes for convenience.
[*][b]Expanded Hangar Area:[/b] New parking options for aircraft with no set limit on the number of planes in hangars.
[*][b]Automatic Route Changes During Runway Shifts:[/b] IFR traffic will adjust to the active runway, and VFR traffic will update their position in the circuit accordingly.
[*][b]IFR Holding System:[/b] To prevent simultaneous approaches, IFR traffic will now hold at designated fixes at the start of approach procedures.
[*][b]New Aircraft and Liveries:[/b] In addition to the A320, B738, C182, and PA28, we’re introducing the AC9, AT72, BE9L, C56X, C206, C208, E50P, GLEX, LJ45, PA34, PA44, SR20, and SR22. Not all aircraft are available yet as we work to balance traffic generation.
[*][b]Direct Base Leg Correction for VFR Approaches:[/b] VFR aircraft can now be cleared for a direct base leg when appropriate, allowing smoother approaches.
[*][b]Radar Zoom Fix on Tutorial Restart:[/b] Resolved issues with radar zoom levels resetting incorrectly or even not working after tutorial restarts.
[*][b]IFR Aircraft Approach Speeds:[/b] Aircraft on approach will now maintain appropriate speeds, eliminating the long final drags some users experienced.
[*][b]Simulation Continuation After Collision:[/b] After an aircraft collision, pressing "Continue" will remove involved aircraft, allowing the simulation to proceed.
[*][b]Out-of-Bounds Aircraft:[/b] Be alert—VFR aircraft that stray too far from the airport will now trigger a Game Over.
[*][b]Updated Fix Names in TMA and Departure Procedures.[/b]
[*][b]Added VFR Route Map.[/b]
[*][b]IFR Arrival and Departure Route Maps fixed[/b]
[*][b]Runway-Specific Procedure Maps for 13/31[/b]
[*][b]Improved 5NM Circle Visibility on TWR Mode Map.[/b]
[*][b]Corrected Map Visibility Selection in APP Mode.[/b]
[*][b]Resolved Taxiway Issues:[/b] Aircraft should no longer taxi out of bounds or head to undefined parking spots.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this update! Despite some remaining bugs, we decided to release it to keep things fresh and incorporate your valuable feedback. Keep it coming, and thank you for all the support!

    [*][b]Weather Control Interface: [/b]Adjust the time of day, weather presets, and surrounding airport lighting.
    [*][b]Runway and Taxiway Lighting Control:[/b] Manage the lighting for better visibility during operations.
    [*][b]Tower Interior Lighting Control: [/b]Customize the lighting within the control tower.
    [*][b]Fixed Temperature and QNH Information:[/b] The meteorological information screen now correctly displays temperature and QNH.
    [*][b]Automatic Runway Exit:[/b] Aircraft will now automatically vacate the runway after landing.
    [*][b]Interchangeable Monitor Displays: [/b]Switch between available monitors in the tower for optimal control.
    [*][b]New Terminal Radar Options Screen:[/b] Customize what information is displayed, including tag sizes, time vector lines, locations of aerodromes, and submap visibility.
    [*][b]Improved Radar Map Movement:[/b] Enhanced the map movement for smoother control.
    [*][b]New Aircraft SR20: [/b]Introducing the SR20 aircraft to diversify your operations.
[/list]

Please note that most features in this new version are available exclusively in the new scenario, accessed via the TestMode menu under the "Dynamic Weather" option. This feature may impact performance, and we are working on optimizations to ensure a seamless experience.

notes.title: Major Update Alert! Exciting Features Await You!
notes.notes:
Hello Air Traffic Controllers,

We're thrilled to announce a significant update for our air traffic control simulator, available in Early Access on Steam. Your valuable feedback has been instrumental in shaping the improvements, and we're excited to introduce a host of new features and enhancements that will elevate your virtual aviation experience.

[b]What's New:[/b]

[olist]
[*][b]Play Without VR Headset:[/b]
Now, you can enjoy the simulator even without a virtual reality headset, providing a more accessible and flexible gaming experience.

[*][b]Revamped Aircraft Movement System:[/b]
We've fine-tuned the aircraft movement system for smoother and more realistic control, enhancing your overall immersion.

[*][b]Arrivals and Departures:[/b]
Witness a more dynamic simulation as aircraft now perform arrivals and departures to and from other airports, adding depth and realism to your air traffic control duties.

[*][b]Subtitles Added:[/b]
To enhance communication, subtitles have been introduced, ensuring that important information is conveyed clearly.

[*][b]Scoring System:[/b]
Test your skills with the new scoring system, adding a competitive edge to your air traffic control prowess.

[*][b]High-Resolution Binoculars:[/b]
Enjoy an upgraded visual experience with binoculars featuring higher resolution, allowing you to observe every detail with precision.

[*][b]Improved Tutorial:[/b]
A new and more accessible tutorial has been implemented to help both new and experienced players master the intricacies of air traffic control.

[*][b]Two Introductory Scenarios:[/b]
Explore two new levels that serve as an immersive introduction to the world of air traffic control.

[*][b]Collision Detection with Game Over:[/b]
Stay on your toes! A collision detection system with a game-over scenario adds an extra layer of challenge and realism.

[*][b]Strip Order Buttons:[/b]
Take control of your workspace with the ability to change the order of strips, optimizing your workflow.

[*][b]Visual Boarding/Deboarding Indicators:[/b]
Keep track of the boarding and deboarding status with new visual indicators on the strips.

[*][b]Runway and Taxiway Model Corrections:[/b]
We've addressed issues with the runway and taxiway models for a more accurate representation of the airfield.

[*][b]Enhanced Scene Lighting:[/b]
Experience improved lighting conditions, enhancing the overall visual quality of the simulation.

[*][b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Various bug fixes have been implemented, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.
[/olist]

We look forward to you diving into these new features and enhancements. Your continued support and feedback is invaluable as we work to make this air traffic control simulator the best it can be.

Thank you for being part of our aviation community!

Take control!
